privacy.title: About your personal data
privacy.body1: Records in this app (meeting records and patrol checks) are used to improve customer service and to keep track of patrol time.
privacy.body2: Only company managers can see the records. Do not enter customer information. Photos and videos are saved in the company’s Google Drive. Do not film customers’ faces. Text written in other languages is sent to an external translation service (Anthropic) to be translated into Japanese.
privacy.body3: Records are used only inside the company and are not deleted.

videoGuide.title: How to make videos smaller
videoGuide.intro: Large videos take a long time to send. With these settings the same length makes a smaller file (from the next video you take).

iphone.s1: Settings → Camera → Record Video: choose "1080p HD at 30 fps" (smaller: "720p HD at 30 fps"). Do not use 4K or 60 fps.
iphone.s3: In Record Video, turn off "HDR Video".
iphone.s4: For a video already taken: open it in Photos → Edit → drag the ends of the frame bar to keep only the part you need.

android.s1: Camera app → ⚙ Settings → "Video size" (Galaxy: "Rear video size"): choose "FHD 1080p 30fps" or "HD 720p". Do not use 4K / UHD or 60fps.
android.s2: Galaxy: ⚙ → "Advanced video options" → turn on "High efficiency videos".
android.s3: If there is "HDR10+ video", turn it off.
android.s4: For a video already taken: open it in Gallery or Google Photos → Edit → trim to the part you need and save.

videoGuide.note: Menu names differ a little by model. Each video can be up to 90 seconds.

installGuide.title: How to add the app to your home screen
installGuide.intro: With an icon on your home screen, the app opens with one tap like a normal app, with a bigger screen.

iphone.s1: Open this app in Safari (it does not work from the browser inside LINE etc.).
iphone.s2: Open the Share menu. It depends on the iOS version:

s2v.ios27: iOS 27: tap the button on the left of the address bar (page menu), or press and hold the address bar → "Share". The bottom-right button now opens tabs.
s2v.ios26: iOS 26: tap "…" at the bottom right → "Share".
s2v.older: iOS 18 or earlier: tap the Share button □↑ at the bottom of the screen.

iphone.s3: Tap "More" or scroll down, then tap "Add to Home Screen".
iphone.s4: iOS 26 and later: check that "Open as Web App" is on. Then tap "Add" at the top right.

android.s4: Tap "Install". The icon appears on the home screen.

installGuide.note: From next time, open it from the "金龍ラーメン専用アプリ" icon on your home screen. The first time, you may need to log in again.
installGuide.version: Check your iOS version in Settings → General → About.
